faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SEBI Security Coordinator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the SEBI Security Coordinator position is 3rd September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates from a recognized university, NDA, or Open University. Additionally, a minimum of 20 years of commissioned service in the Indian Armed Forces (not below Lt Colonel) or 14 years SSC-NT with 6 years of security experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Security Coordinator role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Security Coordinator post is 60 years as of 31st August 2026. There are no minimum age requirements specified.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for SEBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Security Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Security Coordinator post ranges from Rs. 167000 to Rs. 236700 per month, with a consolidated remuneration between Rs. 391714 to Rs. 511714 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Security Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Security Coordinator position in the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for SEBI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for the SEBI Security Coordinator Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Security Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Security Coordinator role will involve an Interview and a Medical Fitness assessment. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this SEBI recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Security Coordinator post is Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400051.

faq.question: Q10. Does SEBI offer any age relaxation for this post?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details for this particular recruitment. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.
